purpose: Owner quantified transverse width: broad sections fit 7–8 tower footprints side by side; short narrow sections can fit about 3.
initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original level-design reference for Not 3A Game, one landscape image.
Input images: Image 1 is the project's original gameplay style/landmark reference; Image 2 is the project's original cartoon tower style reference. Use these only for style and object identity, not map geometry.
Primary request: a naturally winding gray invasion ROAD with strongly variable width. The owner explicitly requires room for SEVEN TO EIGHT TOWERS SIDE BY SIDE ACROSS the broad sections, and about THREE TOWERS SIDE BY SIDE ACROSS short narrow sections. Width must be proven visually by countable tower scale markers, not merely described by a label.
Build the map around those dimensions FIRST. One tower's complete square ground footprint is one unit; roof overhang is not the measurement. Broad portions are 8 to 9 such units wide with clear gray buildable ground, narrower necks are 3 to 4 units wide. The main road spends most of its length broad; pinch points are short. Smoothly taper between them. Tower scale is constant everywhere in this orthographic view. Make the ground expanse much wider relative to towers than a normal walking road.
Composition: very steep elevated orthographic view, no horizon, whole route visible. A single long, open, asymmetrical S meanders across a green meadow from the dark red vortex portal at the upper right to the cyan soul dome at the lower left. Two large unequal smooth bends, generous distance between endpoints, with distinct green land separating the arms. Broad curving reaches alternate with two short narrower necks; widening is integrated naturally into the winding band, not separate round plazas. Both verges follow the meander with worn irregular edges, gray stone slabs and compacted gray earth, grass intruding unevenly at the shoulders. Keep all internal gray ground clear of decorative obstacles.
CRITICAL SCALE OVERLAY: on one broad reach draw exactly EIGHT identical small red-roof Rapid towers in ONE STRAIGHT TRANSVERSE ROW from one grassy verge to the opposite verge. This row is perpendicular to local travel direction, NOT along the road. All eight distinct complete footings must fit on gray ground at the same depth, with small equal gaps and room to see every tower. Make these eight scale towers lightly translucent so they are visibly a planning overlay rather than a recommended full-block defense. A fine white dimension line across their ground bases is labeled "8 TOWERS". On a separate short neck show exactly THREE of the SAME-SIZED translucent Rapid towers in one transverse row across the gray ground, labeled "3 TOWERS". No other towers, no extra row, no circular tower grouping. Ensure both countable rows are large enough in the image to read. The entire road silhouette must accommodate the row geometry rather than shrinking towers or enlarging the grass margins. Around the wide test row there is substantial additional road length in front and behind for multiple future alternating maze rows.
Style: same warm, soft, outlined hand-painted cartoon fantasy as the input project art; yellow/olive short turf, small flowers, a few conifers, pale stone and rusty ore on surrounding green land. Same original dark slate red portal and cyan soul objective. Fixed orthographic scale, soft daylight, readable tower bases and ground separation. This is a scale-study concept, not a screenshot.
Text: small heading "F — VARIABLE WIDTH"; only other text is "8 TOWERS" and "3 TOWERS".
Avoid: thin walking trail, uniformly narrow S, giant towers dominating the road, straight oval arena, capsule shape, enclosed loop, symmetrical islands, right-angle zigzag, full grid overlay, HUD, route arrows, extra mechanics, bridges, cliffs or horizon.
initial_output_status: Discarded: unintended branch and scale row along broad reach rather than clearly transverse.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached original E map concept. Keep its one continuous open S-road centerline from the upper-right red portal to the lower-left cyan soul objective. This map has TWO hairpin curves: a LEFT-HAND bend connecting the top and middle arms, and a RIGHT-HAND bend connecting the middle and bottom arms. Preserve this continuous S topology exactly, without any junction, fork, dead-end, shortcut or road continuing beyond the objective.
Primary change: make this a VARIABLE-WIDTH road measured by countable tower ground footprints. Seven to eight towers must fit ACROSS broad road portions; about three across short narrow portions.
Remove the three existing oversized towers. All replacement towers must have the same small size: the square ground footprint is about one third of the old tower footprint. Landmark scales also reduce to match the small tower scale, retaining their familiar identity. Road and landscape stay large. Thus it feels like a much larger battlefield, not a close-up of oversized defenses.
Widen the long road reaches and the RIGHT-HAND bend to around EIGHT tower footprints across, with some uneven gray shoulders. Narrow only a short part of the LEFT-HAND bend to around THREE of those same footprints across, with a smooth natural taper on each side. The road must continue through two clear rounded bends with green separating its arms. No uniformly narrow trail and no oval plaza.
EXACT SCALE TEST ROW 1: At the RIGHT-HAND bend, where the local road travels from the middle arm DOWN into the lower arm, place EIGHT identical small red-roof Rapid towers side by side in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW on screen, crossing that locally vertical road from its left grass edge to its right grass edge. NOT along the road arm. Every tower must stand on gray ground, with equal small gaps, and all eight complete ground bases must be visible and countable. Their row should occupy approximately the whole local road width. Label the ground-width bracket "8 TOWERS".
EXACT SCALE TEST ROW 2: At the LEFT-HAND bend, where the local road travels from the top arm DOWN into the middle arm, place THREE identical towers of exactly the SAME SIZE in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW on screen across that locally vertical narrower neck, from its left grass edge to its right grass edge. Label its ground-width bracket "3 TOWERS". Widen or narrow the road edges to fit these footprints, not the other way around. Both rows perpendicular to local travel, never parallel. Use lightly translucent towers to indicate planning/scale overlays, not final fully blocking defenses. No other towers.
Keep the E illustration's original soft hand-painted outlined cartoon fantasy materials and overhead orthographic view: worn gray paving/earth, irregular grassy shoulders, warm yellow-green meadow, scattered flowers, conifers and rock resources. Ground plane and original continuous S composition remain. Pull camera back slightly if needed, never crop either end or add a road spur.
Replace E title with small "F — VARIABLE WIDTH". Only two other labels "8 TOWERS" and "3 TOWERS". No HUD, no arrows, no full grid.
